title: Local and global predictors of synapse elimination during motor learning
goal: Reproduce the source's original activity and local-coactivity contrasts between eliminated and retained synapses, and its spatial-plasticity and relative postsynaptic-timing findings, using the complete source-defined populations and indispensable controls for those named results. Preserve the original longitudinal identities, response definitions and nested statistical comparisons. Report mixed-effects likelihood reconstruction as a secondary statistical-method outcome, and future elimination-fate prediction as a prospective extension. Neither result substitutes for primary biological reproduction or establishes same-result improvement.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Empirical longitudinal in vivo neural activity and structural comparisons: activity/task-engagement contrasts, normalized distance-dependent coactivity and local/distant environments; spatial relations to enlargement, shrinkage, formation and elimination with source label-shuffle controls; relative postsynaptic timing, frequency-versus-timing distinction and relationship to local coactivity. Preserve source populations, sensor cohorts, size/activity/structural controls, mouse/dendrite/spine/session identities and nesting. This named family does not require every paper figure or raw acquisition stage.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: secondary_empirical_statistical_method_result: Mixed-effects activity/coactivity-response likelihood reconstruction and hypothesis-based model selection. Likelihood gain is not reconstruction of the complete biological contrast family. [coverage: secondary_interface_unqualified]
prospective_extension: Held-mouse or held-dendrite future elimination-fate prediction and the local Brier component. Retrospective outcome-conditioned populations must not be relabelled prospective prediction.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
